description: Common English labels for data work template pages.

labels.paramDescMaxSymbolicTerms: Maximum retained polynomial Symbolic Regression term count
labels.paramDescDimensionReductionMode: Feature reduction: AUTO, PCA, or NONE. PCA keeps representative source columns and never stores synthetic PC columns.
labels.paramDescEstimationMode: Linear estimator: AUTO, OLS, or ROBUST_IRLS. AUTO selects robust iteration only after outlier and validation checks.
labels.paramDescMonteCarloMode: Stability validation: OFF, AUTO, BOOTSTRAP, or REPEATED_HOLDOUT. Final correction values are never randomized.
labels.paramDescMonteCarloMaxRows: Maximum rows used only for stability validation (100-10000)
labels.paramDescBanffMode: Single-ratio candidate: AUTO, RATIO, or OFF. This is a limited Banff-inspired feature, not full Banff.
